decision.title: New order status value: refunded
decision.question: API 2.0.0 adds refunded to OrderStatus. Lumen_Books_OrderStatus is a closed enum (pending, paid, shipped, cancelled), so any order the API returns as refunded makes Order.status fail on lumen_books_orders, lumen_books_order and lumen_books_createOrder, and the orders status filter cannot ask for refunded orders. How should the schema take the new value?

choices.label: Add refunded to Lumen_Books_OrderStatus (and to the status filter doc comment)
Type Order.status as String so future values pass through
